protocol.methods: moments on all cases; independent dadi diffusion on matched cases
protocol.vcf_checks: cases 0 and 12; map binary alleles to A/C, floor(position)+1; compare all spectra
protocol.exposure: complete 100 Mb simulation; all bases callable; no missing genotypes
limitations: Six diagnostic parameter points, not a random prior validation sample
Two chromosomes per point/history cannot establish calibrated coverage
Both numerical solvers assume the same two-epoch biological model
No interval coverage claim; failures and incomplete cases remain in denominator
Continuous sites may share an integer VCF position after rounding
